lines.t: All you've said in the day shall come to nothing
And all your precise predictions shall fail
For I may take them before or after
For I am God
Therefore keep watch
For you know not the time of the Lord's coming
For you know not the time of the Lord's coming
Behold, the first election is made, the time of bundling past.
Thick clouds have risen in the west, the hard rains have come.
Therefore keep watch
For you know not the time of the Lord's coming
Who in all the earth is able to prevent it
Or hinder it when it arrives
No mighty wind blows in the east
Yet who is aware of it
Until it has overtaken them
Until it has overtaken them
Whether it be in the first or in the second
Or in the third watch of the night
You know not the time of his return
You know not the day or the hour
You know not the day or the hour
Therefore keep watch
Therefore keep watch
For you know not the time of the Lord's coming
For you know not the time of the Lord's coming
You know not the day or the hour
says the Lord.
